nodes.label: Container Environment Variables Reference (Doc)
nodes.rationale: Reference of every container variable: general (FRONTEND_URL, REGISTRATION_ALLOWED, ALLOW_EMBEDDED_LOGIN, MICROFRONTEND_HOST_FOLDER, ALLOWED_ORIGINS, LOG_LEVEL), MongoDB (NOSQL_DATABASE_*), Redis (REDIS_URL/PASSWORD), SMTP (EMAIL_SMTP_*), JWT_SECRET, Auth0 (AUTH0_*), Azure Entra ID (AZURE_ENTRAID_*) and Google OAuth (GOOGLE_*).
